# Wyelee — Furniture Assembly & Installation

> IKEA and flatpack furniture assembly service for homes and businesses in Adelaide, Sydney, Brisbane, Perth and across Australia. Customers send their order details or a photo and receive a quote within 24 hours. Phone/SMS 0432 470 313. Email Kenleong23@wyeleeassembly.com.au.

## Services
- [Furniture Assembly](https://wyeleeassembly.com.au/furniture-assembly/): any flatpack furniture from IKEA, Fantastic Furniture, Officeworks, Bunnings, Harvey Norman, Amart and online stores — beds, wardrobes, desks, drawers, bookshelves, TV units, sofas, outdoor and office furniture.
- [Wardrobe Assembly](https://wyeleeassembly.com.au/wardrobe-assembly/): IKEA PAX and other sliding-door, walk-in, free-standing and fitted wardrobes, anchored to the wall.
- [Disassembly Service](https://wyeleeassembly.com.au/disassembly-service/): careful dismantling for moves, fittings bagged and labelled per item, optional re-assembly.
- [IKEA Kitchen Assembly](https://wyeleeassembly.com.au/ikea-kitchen-assembly/): assembly of IKEA METOD kitchen cabinets (carcasses, doors, drawers, hinges, legs, plinths). No plumbing, electrical or benchtop work.

## Get a quote
- [Quote form](https://wyeleeassembly.com.au/quote/): suburb and postcode, items (name, article number or link), condition, photos, preferred days — quote within 24 hours.
